sources.match_reason: Seed-only record independently matched to Project Kestrel; location corrected from Kansas/Wyandotte seed to Kansas City, Missouri / Platte County Northland KCI-29 project based on Port KC and local reporting.

contradictions.details: Original seed placed the project in Kansas City, Wyandotte County, Kansas. Port KC and local/trade sources identify Project Kestrel as a Kansas City, Missouri Northland/KCI-29 project in the KCI/I-29 corridor, with local reporting placing it in Platte County.

Port KC announced 379 acres and six hyperscale data centers totaling up to 1.8 million sq ft. Data Center Dynamics later reported a Shenandoah Computing LLC acquisition of about 430 acres and current plans for five 500,000 sq ft data centers plus a 44.2-acre Evergy substation section.

Baxtel lists the facility as under construction, while reviewed official Port KC sources only confirm local approvals and planned 2026 first-phase construction. No official permit, inspection, or construction-start record was located.
